name: 像素游戏风

source.library: RHSTORY 画风库（服务端全量）
source.original_name: 像素游戏风 ｜ Pixel Game Style

style_tokens: 16-bit pixel art game sprite, crisp square pixels, limited 24-color palette, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, thick 1px dark outline, flat shading, readable silhouette at small size, retro arcade look
negative_extra: anti-aliasing, smooth gradient, blurry edges, high resolution photo, 3d render, vector, soft shadow, painterly
sprite_hint: 生成 512 或 1024 方图后，用最近邻（NEAREST）缩到 64/128 网格；严禁 LANCZOS 缩放，会把像素糊成半透明边
risk: AI 出的「像素」常带半像素与渐变 → 必须后处理量化到有限调色板；主体太小会糊
notes: 小游戏里最稳的一档：体积小、识别度高、程序化 UI 极易统一。适合先用灰盒验证再上素材。
